name: sled alternating single leg negative press
description: A sled leg press done one leg at a time, with a slow lowering phase to build leg strength.
instructions: Sit in the sled with feet on the platform and release the safety.
Press the platform up with both legs and lock out gently.
Shift the load to one leg and lower it slowly for 3-4 seconds.
Press back up with both legs.
Alternate the lowering leg each rep and never let your lower back round.
